decisions.reason: The necessary metadata changes are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, including the non-direct PDF destination and Lit Protocol gated-viewer target.
The accepted proposal changes NFT-gated access and the metadata destination, but does not require changing the certificate contents, labels, or optional post-verification download behavior.
Lit Protocol adds ownership gating before display but does not replace or alter the existing read-only PDF.js rendering requirement or its entry points.
The candidate already requires Pinata IPFS storage with takedown control, and the accepted gating proposal leaves those storage attributes unchanged.
The source decision establishes access implementation behavior but does not direct any corresponding FAQ copy change.
Book-access gating does not change the referral commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, timing, or limits.
The access-flow decision does not alter any landing-page hero copy, layout, CTA, or visual-emphasis attribute.
The accepted gated-viewer architecture does not entail a change to landing-page mechanics or prize copy.
The source decision does not request changes to the About page's technology, process, feature, or vision content.
Automatic verification of current NFT ownership enforces access but does not change which book entitlement or NFT-associated state transfers on resale.
The book-access proposal is unrelated to prize delivery and does not alter automatic wallet transfer behavior.
NFT-gated PDF access does not change Small Block ticket accounting, reset behavior, or dashboard ticket display.
